Source: synthetic_railway/temporal_confidence.py
Class: CausalConfidenceFilter
Method: update
Selected pipeline: window=3, method='mean'

The filter associates current detections with prior tracks and accumulates confidence history.
The original statement supports either a median or mean; the selected evaluation uses mean.

Original excerpt:
history.append(float(score))
if len(history)==self.window:output[index]=float(np.median(history) if self.method=='median' else np.mean(history))

No future frames are used. Original local evaluation reports identify these results as development measurements, not independent tests.
